entries.test: Whether Imagen 4, as of mid-2025, still failed noncanonical prompts like the left-hand-writing, right-wrist-watch at 3:20 test, judged by reproduced outputs or published evaluations.
entries.note: 'Not much better' is vague, but the plain reading is that Imagen 4 still fails such compositional prompts, and his own example shows a failure.

entries.test: Whether Imagen 4 in mid-2025 rendered text noticeably better than earlier versions but usually failed to show requested watch times other than 10:10, judged by reproduced prompts or benchmark reports.
entries.note: 'Dreadful' is loose, but the plain reading is that requested clock times are usually wrong.

entries.test: Whether Imagen 4 in mid-2025 reliably interpreted unusual compositional prompts (role reversals, attribute binding, clock times), judged by reproduced tests or published compositional benchmarks.
entries.note: Whether outputs are reliable can be tested. The claim that weak language understanding is the cause is his interpretation and harder to settle.
